answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity earns full weight after deals with 12 distinct counterparties. A newcomer locks 20 POA in a diversity vault; each real trade adds to its diversity signal, while a cluster trading only with itself never clears the bar. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 12,000 partners, and at 5 POA per fake trade the bill is 60,000 POA. An honest agent pays one deposit; its voyage across partners builds the signal for free.
